$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/alerts.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). Office only: apps/factory-api's alerts (B-W2a-33) keep the rules, and the clustered scheduler (tenant system context) evaluates them, raises and clears alerts and fires timers, all through command(); people acknowledge, assign, snooze and resolve alerts in the office; the modules set and cancel their timers inside their own commands. The floor and portal/link sessions read and write nothing here in W2a. AlertEvent is append-only (`@append-only`; the …_platform_w2a_guards triggers refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login); a rule is switched off, an alert resolved, a timer cancelled, never deleted (the triggers refuse DELETE for every login). After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

AlertRule.about: The office edits the built-in rules and its own (numbers, place, recipients, channels, cooldown, on or off); the scheduler reads them.

Alert.about: The scheduler raises and clears alerts; the office reads them and acknowledges, assigns, snoozes and resolves them with a note.

AlertEvent.about: The history of each alert: the scheduler and the office add one row per thing done and read it; nobody changes or removes one.

DueTimer.about: The modules set and cancel the timers of their records' dates; the scheduler reads the due ones and fires them.
